note: pcb_memcache is a glue-shim submodule of pcb that registers ONE service, cache.backend.permanent_memcache (PermanentMemcacheBackendFactory -> PermanentMemcacheBackend). This site has no live Memcache server configured, so per the campaign brief the medium/hard cases are grounded in the local service/plugin definition and module lifecycle (server-independent): the observable live state is whether pcb_memcache is installed and its backend service is registered in the container - checkable with \Drupal::hasService('cache.backend.permanent_memcache') and \Drupal::moduleHandler()->moduleExists('pcb_memcache') - not on a running Memcache instance. At baseline both pcb_memcache and its dependency memcache are uninstalled; enabling pcb_memcache also enables memcache, so cleanup/reset uninstall BOTH to restore baseline.

evals.prompt: The pcb_memcache submodule of Permanent Cache Bin adds a Memcache-backed permanent cache backend. What is the machine name of the cache backend service it registers, and what does its factory extend?
evals.expected_output: It registers the service cache.backend.permanent_memcache, whose factory PermanentMemcacheBackendFactory extends the Memcache module's backend factory and returns a PermanentMemcacheBackend (Memcache backend + pcb's PermanentBackendTrait).

evals.prompt: With pcb_memcache enabled, how do I make a cache bin named 'stock' use the Memcache permanent backend (surviving drush cr)?
evals.expected_output: Register a cache.stock service tagged { name: cache.bin, default_backend: cache.backend.permanent_memcache }, or in settings.php set $settings['cache']['bins']['stock'] = 'cache.backend.permanent_memcache'.

evals.prompt: What does the pcb_memcache submodule depend on, and what else is needed for it to actually store cache in Memcache?
evals.expected_output: It depends on the contrib Memcache module (memcache:memcache >= 2.0) and the parent pcb module, and needs a working Memcache server wired into Drupal for the bin to actually be stored in Memcache.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the live service container and tell me the exact machine name of the permanent Memcache cache backend service that is currently available.
evals.expected_output: The service cache.backend.permanent_memcache is registered (pcb_memcache is installed). Check with: drush php:eval 'var_export(\Drupal::hasService("cache.backend.permanent_memcache"));'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site a permanent Memcache cache backend is available. Inspect the live site and tell me which module provides it (which pcb submodule is installed).
evals.expected_output: The pcb_memcache submodule is installed (drush pm:list shows pcb_memcache enabled); it provides the cache.backend.permanent_memcache service.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, make a permanent Memcache cache backend service (cache.backend.permanent_memcache) available by enabling pcb's Memcache integration submodule (and its Memcache dependency). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the pcb_memcache submodule (drush en pcb_memcache -y, which also enables memcache); afterwards \Drupal::hasService('cache.backend.permanent_memcache') is TRUE and the module is installed.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, pcb's Memcache permanent-cache integration submodule is currently installed but the ops team wants it removed so its permanent Memcache backend service is no longer registered. Uninstall the pcb_memcache submodule. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Uninstall the pcb_memcache submodule (drush pmu pcb_memcache -y); afterwards \Drupal::moduleHandler()->moduleExists('pcb_memcache') is FALSE and \Drupal::hasService('cache.backend.permanent_memcache') is FALSE.
